question: What supreme accomplishment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation can be united in one attainment.
This attainment is described as a great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment can make one dear to the yoginīs.
inference: Therefore, the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation renders a practitioner dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: Through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation, one may become dear to the yoginīs.
